meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话，自动回忆历史并沉淀洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在开发智能体，需要让它记住多轮对话的关键信息
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building AI agents that need to remember context across conversations.

howto.what: 在 agent 容器里装上 mnemon 并注册 Claude Code hooks:Claude 每次回应前会先调取过去的相关记忆,每轮结束后把新要点写入。记忆存在 .claude/ 挂载目录中,容器重启后仍然保留。
howto.when: 当你给使用默认 Claude provider 的 agent 组安装本技能时生效;容器每次启动都会运行 mnemon setup 注册 hooks。若该组配置了别的 provider(如 opencode),这些 hooks 不会运行。

say.text: 给使用默认 Claude provider 的组装上 mnemon 持久记忆
say.note: 会改 Dockerfile、entrypoint 并重建镜像

say.text: 检查一下 mnemon hooks 有没有注册进 settings.json
say.note: 在运行中的容器里查看该文件

say.text: 清空这个 agent 的记忆,把 mnemon 目录删掉
say.note: 先停容器,再删宿主机上的 mnemon/

howto.what_en: Installs mnemon in the agent container and registers Claude Code hooks: Claude recalls relevant past memory before replying and stores new insights after each turn. Memory lives in the .claude/ mount and survives container restarts.
howto.when_en: Applies to agent groups on the default Claude provider; hooks only fire under --target claude-code. Each container start runs mnemon setup to register hooks. Other providers won't run them.

say_en.text: Install mnemon persistent memory on the default Claude provider group
say_en.note: Edits the Dockerfile and entrypoint, then rebuilds

say_en.text: Check whether the mnemon hooks are registered in settings.json
say_en.note: Inspects settings.json inside the running container

say_en.text: Clear this agent's memory by deleting the mnemon directory
say_en.note: Stop the container first, then delete mnemon/ on the host
